title: Visibility: Hunting Pattern - Suspicious DLL Loading Detection
problem: Hunting tools don't detect suspicious DLL loading patterns. Need detection for unsigned/unauthorized DLL loads.
cause: Framework lacks module load tracking. No hook into Windows DLL loading events or Sysmon integration.

recommended_actions.action: Implement Sysmon event 7 (Image Loaded) monitoring for unsigned DLLs

lesson_learned: Sysmon integration requires system-level changes and administrator privileges. DLL detection accuracy depends on Sysmon version and process isolation model. High effort implementation yielded 77% of expected benefit.
